senses.sense_definition: A female calf born as a twin with a male calf that is sexually imperfect or infertile.

examples.text: The farmer realized the heifer was a <w>freemartin</w> because she was born alongside a bull calf.
Veterinarians often examine a <w>freemartin</w> to confirm her reproductive status after birth.

senses.sense_definition: Any female animal that is born sterile or infertile.

examples.text: The breeder identified the cat as a <w>freemartin</w> after confirming she could not reproduce.
It is rare to describe a household pet as a <w>freemartin</w> unless she was born with congenital infertility.
